title: Hold an exploration licence
what: Hold an exploration licence (or other mining authorisation) from the state before prospecting or exploring for minerals.

sources.title: Mineral Resources Development Act 1995 (Tas)
sources.quote: person must not, on an area of land comprised in a licence, explore for minerals to which the licence relates, unless the person – (a) is the holder of the licence;

reach.note: Mineral exploration; exploring as part of a mining operation also needs the licence.
